common_conditions: Primary MC system; TS23.280 V19.9.0 §10.6.1 high-level flow
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: User authentication may precede or follow SIP registration; it may be separate or integrated. Single authentication can support multiple service authorizations, not blanket access. Signalling UA establishes a secure connection for SIP-level authentication and registration.
Third-party registration is optional. If PLMN LCS supplies location, share UE IMSI with the service server during that registration; include UE L4S capabilities as specified.

limitations: Stage2 only; TS33.180 authentication/token mechanics and Stage3 REGISTER encoding are not checked.
This topic uses V19.9.0; no equivalence with V19.10.1 is asserted.
